title: Polynomial-time binary certificate length
statement: For all $C,c\\in\\mathbb{N}$, the function sending a bit string $x$ to the bit-list representation of the natural number $C(|x|+1)^c$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: For all $C, c \in \mathbb{N}$, the function sending a bit string $x$ to the little-endian binary representation of $C(|x|+1)^c$ (the empty word when this value is $0$) is polynomial-time computable.
